Bug report: get_page(items, 1, 10) skips the first 10 items and returns the second page's items. Fix the bug at its root. Touch only non-test files.

--- slicing.py ---
def page_bounds(page, size):
    """Zero-based [start, end) indexes for a 1-based page number."""
    start = page * size
    return start, start + size

--- paginate.py ---
from slicing import page_bounds


def get_page(items, page, size):
    start, end = page_bounds(page, size)
    return items[start:end]


def page_count(total, size):
    return (total + size - 1) // size

--- export.py ---
from slicing import page_bounds


def page_label(page, size, total):
    start, end = page_bounds(page, size)
    return "%d-%d of %d" % (start + 1, min(end, total), total)
